title: hyperbilling-mcp docs
nav.label: Sections
hero.title: HyperBilling over MCP
hero.body: A Model Context Protocol server that exposes the Megazone HyperBilling Open API as read-only tools. One tool call is one HyperBilling request, with nothing cached or rewritten in between.
arch.title: Architecture
arch.direct.hint: An agent connects straight to this server.
arch.litellm.hint: A LiteLLM proxy sits in front as the MCP gateway.
flow.label: Architecture: an AI agent calls hyperbilling-mcp over MCP, and the server sends one HTTPS request to the HyperBilling Open API and returns its answer.
flow.agent.detail: kagent, Claude, or any MCP client
flow.step1: The agent picks a tool and calls it with its arguments.
flow.step2: The server forwards the caller's credential headers.
flow.step3: HyperBilling returns the billing rows as JSON.
flow.step4: The agent answers the cost question from those rows.
connect.title: Connect
connect.body: The server speaks streamable HTTP at /mcp on this host. Point an MCP client at it and send your HyperBilling credentials as headers.
connect.prompt.body: Or let the agent set itself up. Copy this prompt, paste it into an MCP client such as Claude Code, and replace the email with your HyperBilling login. The URL is the address this page was opened at.
connect.prompt:
Register the hyperbilling MCP server in my user-scope MCP configuration.

- Name: hyperbilling
- Transport: HTTP (streamable HTTP)
- URL: {{origin}}/mcp
- Header X-Client-Id: user@example.com
- Header X-Client-Secret: ${HYPERBILLING_API_KEY}

Keep ${HYPERBILLING_API_KEY} as an environment variable reference. Do not ask for the key and do not write its value anywhere.
Then call hyperbilling_list_linked_accounts to confirm the connection.
connect.start: Start with hyperbilling_list_linked_accounts. Every other tool takes the account IDs it returns.
litellm.title: Through LiteLLM
litellm.body: Register this server on a LiteLLM proxy to give every model and client behind the proxy the same billing tools, with LiteLLM handling keys, access control, and usage logs.
litellm.label: Architecture with LiteLLM: clients call the LiteLLM proxy, which calls hyperbilling-mcp over MCP, which sends one HTTPS request to the HyperBilling Open API.
litellm.clients.detail: Anything that holds a LiteLLM key
litellm.config: Add the server to the LiteLLM config.yaml. The http transport is streamable HTTP.
litellm.endpoint: Clients then connect to /hyperbilling/mcp on the proxy, or to /mcp/ for every server at once. LiteLLM prefixes each tool with the server name, so the search tool becomes hyperbilling-hyperbilling_search_billing.
litellm.credentials: For credentials, either configure the fallback credential on this server and send nothing from LiteLLM, or let each caller send its own as x-mcp-hyperbilling-x-client-id and x-mcp-hyperbilling-x-client-secret, which LiteLLM forwards as the two HyperBilling headers.
auth.title: Authentication
auth.body: HyperBilling authenticates each request with two headers. The server forwards the pair a caller sends, so a caller sees only the linked accounts its own key can read.
auth.client_id: The HyperBilling login email that issued the key.
auth.client_secret: The Open API key from the HyperBilling console. It expires one year after it is issued.
auth.fallback: A caller that sends neither header uses the fallback credential when the operator configured one. Without a fallback the call is refused before it reaches HyperBilling.
limits.title: Limits
limits.body: These are HyperBilling limits. The server passes them through unchanged.
errors.title: Errors
errors.body: A request HyperBilling rejects comes back as a tool error that carries the API message, so the agent can correct the call. Only a request that got no response fails the MCP call itself.
errors.204: No billing data matches the query. Returned as a normal, empty result.
errors.400: A required field is missing, a value is malformed, or a limit was exceeded.
errors.401: A header is missing, the key expired, or the client ID does not own the key. The API body is dropped because it echoes the key.
errors.403: Authenticated, but no linked account is visible to this client ID.
errors.429: The hourly request limit was exceeded. Retry later.
endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.readyz: Readiness. 503 until the HyperBilling API has been reached once, 200 from then on.
endpoints.metrics: Prometheus metrics for tool calls, tool latency, and API requests.
tools.title: Tools
tools.body: Generated from the tool definitions this server registers, so it always matches what tools/list returns.
